name: rabbit intern
desc: Rabbit's all-purpose software agent that delivers finished websites, reports and decks.
desc_zh: rabbit 的通用软件智能体，直接交付成品网站、报告和幻灯片。
solves: Outsourcing a website or a research deck means briefing a human team; intern takes the brief and comes back with the finished artifact.
solves_zh: 外包一个网站或研究报告要给人类团队反复对接；intern 接过需求，直接带回成品。
best_for: You are out to lunch and want a market-research presentation waiting when you get back.
best_for_zh: 外出吃个午饭，回来就想看到一份市场调研演示已经做好时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — rabbit.tech blog and newsroom directories）。 Missing from the ledger. rabbit's first software product alongside the R1 hardware, launched 2025-06-13. The launch page itself carries no date; the date is on the newsroom index beside the headline, and the launch page confirms the product. rabbit.tech/intern returns 404, so the homepage is the product site. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.rabbit.tech/newsroom 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://www.rabbit.tech/）。
